# Wayfarer Stays

> Browse independent boutique hotels in Brazil, compare room prices and availability, and make or manage a reservation.

## Main pages

- [Find a stay](/): Search stays in Rio de Janeiro or São Paulo, select dates and guests, and explore hotel details.
- [My trips](/): Find reservations by the email used at booking and cancel eligible reservations.

## Notes

- Prices are displayed in Brazilian reais (BRL).
- Reservations are confirmed immediately and paid at the property.
- This local demonstration does not collect payment card details.
